<?php
final readonly class Rational
{
    public int $p;
    public int $q;
    public function __construct(int $p, int $q = 1)
    {
        if ($q === 0) {
            throw new RuntimeException("division by zero");
        }
        if ($q < 0) {
            $p = -$p;
            $q = -$q;
        }
        $a = abs($p);
        $b = $q;
        while ($b) {
            [$a, $b] = [$b, $a % $b];
        }
        $this->p = intdiv($p, $a);
        $this->q = intdiv($q, $a);
    }
    public function plus(self $b): self
    {
        return new self($this->p * $b->q + $b->p * $this->q, $this->q * $b->q);
    }
    public function times(self $b): self
    {
        return new self($this->p * $b->p, $this->q * $b->q);
    }
    public function negative(): self
    {
        return new self(-$this->p, $this->q);
    }
}
final readonly class Expr
{
    public function __construct(
        public int $kind,
        public Rational $q,
        public string $name,
        public array $args,
    ) {}
}
function num(int|Rational $p, int $q = 1): Expr
{
    return new Expr(5, $p instanceof Rational ? $p : new Rational($p, $q), "", []);
}
function node(int $k, array $a = [], string $s = ""): Expr
{
    return new Expr($k, new Rational(0), $s, $a);
}
const FUNCTIONS = ["sin", "cos", "tan", "exp", "ln", "sqrt"];
$zero = num(0);
$one = num(1);
$minus = num(-1);
$half = num(1, 2);
function compare(Expr $a, Expr $b): int
{
    if ($a->kind !== $b->kind) {
        return $a->kind <=> $b->kind;
    }
    if ($a->kind === 5) {
        return $a->q->p * $b->q->q <=> $b->q->p * $a->q->q;
    }
    if ($a->name !== $b->name) {
        return strcmp($a->name, $b->name);
    }
    for ($i = 0; $i < min(count($a->args), count($b->args)); $i++) {
        $c = compare($a->args[$i], $b->args[$i]);
        if ($c) {
            return $c;
        }
    }
    return count($a->args) <=> count($b->args);
}
function integerForm(Expr $f): bool
{
    return $f->kind === 5 && $f->q->q === 1;
}
function negativePower(Expr $f): bool
{
    return $f->kind === 3 && $f->args[1]->kind === 5 && $f->args[1]->q->p < 0;
}
function baseOf(Expr $f): Expr
{
    return $f->kind === 3 ? $f->args[0] : $f;
}
function exponentOf(Expr $f): Expr
{
    global $one;
    return $f->kind === 3 ? $f->args[1] : $one;
}
function coefficient(Expr $f): array
{
    if ($f->kind === 5) {
        return [$f->q, []];
    }
    if ($f->kind === 2) {
        return $f->args[0]->kind === 5
            ? [$f->args[0]->q, array_slice($f->args, 1)]
            : [new Rational(1), $f->args];
    }
    return [new Rational(1), [$f]];
}
function product(Rational $c, array $a): Expr
{
    if (!$a) {
        return num($c);
    }
    if ($c->p !== $c->q) {
        array_unshift($a, num($c));
    }
    return count($a) === 1 ? $a[0] : node(2, $a);
}
function exponentCompare(Expr $a, Expr $b): int
{
    if ($a->kind === 5 && $b->kind !== 5) {
        return -1;
    }
    if ($a->kind !== 5 && $b->kind === 5) {
        return 1;
    }
    return compare($a, $b);
}
function termCompare(Expr $a, Expr $b): int
{
    global $zero;
    $x = coefficient($a)[1];
    $y = coefficient($b)[1];
    $bases = [];
    foreach ([...$x, ...$y] as $f) {
        $b = baseOf($f);
        if (!in_array($b, $bases)) {
            $bases[] = $b;
        }
    }
    usort($bases, "compare");
    foreach ($bases as $b) {
        $u = $v = $zero;
        foreach ($x as $t) {
            if (baseOf($t) == $b) {
                $u = exponentOf($t);
            }
        }
        foreach ($y as $t) {
            if (baseOf($t) == $b) {
                $v = exponentOf($t);
            }
        }
        $c = exponentCompare($v, $u);
        if ($c) {
            return $c;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
function add(Expr ...$operands): Expr
{
    global $zero;
    $terms = [];
    foreach ($operands as $f) {
        if ($f->kind === 1) {
            array_push($terms, ...$f->args);
        } elseif (
            $f->kind === 2 &&
            count($f->args) === 2 &&
            $f->args[0]->kind === 5 &&
            $f->args[1]->kind === 1
        ) {
            foreach ($f->args[1]->args as $t) {
                $terms[] = multiply($f->args[0], $t);
            };
        } else {
            $terms[] = $f;
        }
    }
    $keys = [];
    $values = [];
    foreach ($terms as $f) {
        [$c, $m] = coefficient($f);
        $i = array_search($m, $keys);
        if ($i === false) {
            $keys[] = $m;
            $values[] = $c;
        } else {
            $values[$i] = $values[$i]->plus($c);
        }
    }
    $built = [];
    foreach ($keys as $i => $m) {
        if ($values[$i]->p) {
            $built[] = product($values[$i], $m);
        }
    }
    usort($built, "termCompare");
    return !$built ? $zero : (count($built) === 1 ? $built[0] : node(1, $built));
}
function multiply(Expr ...$operands): Expr
{
    global $zero;
    $c = new Rational(1);
    $bases = [];
    $groups = [];
    $factors = [];
    foreach ($operands as $f) {
        array_push($factors, ...$f->kind === 2 ? $f->args : [$f]);
    }
    foreach ($factors as $f) {
        if ($f->kind === 5) {
            $c = $c->times($f->q);
        } else {
            $b = baseOf($f);
            $i = array_search($b, $bases);
            if ($i === false) {
                $bases[] = $b;
                $groups[] = [$f];
            } else {
                $groups[$i][] = $f;
            }
        }
    }
    if (!$c->p) {
        return $zero;
    }
    $r = [];
    foreach ($groups as $i => $g) {
        $r[] = count($g) === 1 ? $g[0] : power($bases[$i], add(...array_map("exponentOf", $g)));
    }
    $regroup = false;
    $seen = [];
    foreach ($r as $f) {
        $b = baseOf($f);
        if (in_array($f->kind, [2, 5]) || in_array($b, $seen)) {
            $regroup = true;
        }
        $seen[] = $b;
    }
    if ($regroup) {
        return multiply(num($c), ...$r);
    }
    usort($r, fn($a, $b) => compare(baseOf($a), baseOf($b)));
    return product($c, $r);
}
function integerRoot(int $v, int $d): ?int
{
    if ($v === 1) {
        return 1;
    }
    if ($d > 20) {
        return null;
    }
    $r = (int) round($v ** (1 / $d));
    for ($s = max(0, $r - 1); $s <= $r + 1; $s++) {
        $a = 1;
        for ($i = 0; $i < $d && $a <= $v; $i++) {
            $a *= $s;
        }
        if ($a === $v) {
            return $s;
        }
    }
    return null;
}
function rationalPower(Rational $b, int $n): Expr
{
    if ($n < 0) {
        $b = new Rational($b->q, $b->p);
        $n = -$n;
    }
    $r = new Rational(1);
    while ($n) {
        if ($n % 2) {
            $r = $r->times($b);
        }
        $n = intdiv($n, 2);
        if ($n) {
            $b = $b->times($b);
        }
    }
    return num($r);
}
function power(Expr $b, Expr $x): Expr
{
    global $zero, $one;
    if ($x == $zero) {
        return $one;
    }
    if ($x == $one) {
        return $b;
    }
    if ($b->kind === 5) {
        if ($b == $one) {
            return $one;
        }
        if ($x->kind !== 5) {
            return node(3, [$b, $x]);
        }
        if (!$b->q->p) {
            if ($x->q->p > 0) {
                return $zero;
            }
            throw new RuntimeException("division by zero");
        }
        if (integerForm($x)) {
            return rationalPower($b->q, $x->q->p);
        }
        if ($b->q->p > 0) {
            $s = integerRoot($b->q->p, $x->q->q);
            $t = integerRoot($b->q->q, $x->q->q);
            if ($s !== null && $t !== null) {
                return rationalPower(new Rational($s, $t), $x->q->p);
            }
        }
    } elseif (integerForm($x)) {
        if ($b->kind === 3) {
            return power($b->args[0], multiply($b->args[1], $x));
        }
        if ($b->kind === 2) {
            return multiply(...array_map(fn($f) => power($f, $x), $b->args));
        }
    }
    return node(3, [$b, $x]);
}
function applyFunction(string $s, Expr $a): Expr
{
    global $zero, $one, $minus, $half;
    if ($s === "sqrt") {
        return power($a, $half);
    }
    if ($a == $zero && in_array($s, ["sin", "tan"])) {
        return $zero;
    }
    if ($a == $zero && in_array($s, ["cos", "exp"])) {
        return $one;
    }
    if ($a == $one && $s === "ln") {
        return $zero;
    }
    if (in_array($s, ["sin", "cos", "tan"]) && coefficient($a)[0]->p < 0) {
        $r = applyFunction($s, multiply($minus, $a));
        return $s === "cos" ? $r : multiply($minus, $r);
    }
    if (
        $a->kind === 4 &&
        (($s === "exp" && $a->name === "ln") || ($s === "ln" && $a->name === "exp"))
    ) {
        return $a->args[0];
    }
    return node(4, [$a], $s);
}
function variables(Expr $f): array
{
    $r = $f->kind === 0 ? [$f->name] : [];
    foreach ($f->args as $a) {
        array_push($r, ...variables($a));
    }
    $r = array_values(array_unique($r));
    sort($r, SORT_STRING);
    return $r;
}
function derivative(Expr $f, string $v): Expr
{
    global $zero, $one, $minus;
    if ($f->kind === 5) {
        return $zero;
    }
    if ($f->kind === 0) {
        return $f->name === $v ? $one : $zero;
    }
    if ($f->kind === 1) {
        return add(...array_map(fn($t) => derivative($t, $v), $f->args));
    }
    if ($f->kind === 2) {
        $r = [];
        foreach ($f->args as $i => $t) {
            $a = $f->args;
            $a[$i] = derivative($t, $v);
            $r[] = multiply(...$a);
        }
        return add(...$r);
    }
    if ($f->kind === 3) {
        [$b, $x] = $f->args;
        if (!in_array($v, variables($x))) {
            return multiply($x, power($b, add($x, $minus)), derivative($b, $v));
        }
        if (!in_array($v, variables($b))) {
            return multiply($f, applyFunction("ln", $b), derivative($x, $v));
        }
        return multiply(
            $f,
            add(
                multiply(derivative($x, $v), applyFunction("ln", $b)),
                multiply($x, derivative($b, $v), power($b, $minus)),
            ),
        );
    }
    $a = $f->args[0];
    $h = match ($f->name) {
        "sin" => applyFunction("cos", $a),
        "cos" => multiply($minus, applyFunction("sin", $a)),
        "tan" => power(applyFunction("cos", $a), num(-2)),
        "exp" => $f,
        default => power($a, $minus),
    };
    return multiply($h, derivative($a, $v));
}
function rebuild(Expr $f, array $a): Expr
{
    return match ($f->kind) {
        1 => add(...$a),
        2 => multiply(...$a),
        3 => power(...$a),
        default => applyFunction($f->name, $a[0]),
    };
}
function substitute(Expr $f, array $m): Expr
{
    if ($f->kind === 0) {
        return $m[$f->name] ?? $f;
    }
    if ($f->kind === 5) {
        return $f;
    }
    return rebuild($f, array_map(fn($t) => substitute($t, $m), $f->args));
}
function terms(Expr $f): array
{
    return $f->kind === 1 ? $f->args : [$f];
}
function distribute(Expr $a, Expr $b): Expr
{
    $r = [];
    foreach (terms($a) as $x) {
        foreach (terms($b) as $y) {
            $r[] = multiply($x, $y);
        };
    }
    return add(...$r);
}
function expandForm(Expr $f): Expr
{
    if (in_array($f->kind, [0, 5])) {
        return $f;
    }
    $a = array_map("expandForm", $f->args);
    if ($f->kind === 2) {
        $r = $a[0];
        foreach (array_slice($a, 1) as $t) {
            $r = distribute($r, $t);
        }
        return $r;
    }
    if ($f->kind === 3 && $a[0]->kind === 1 && integerForm($a[1]) && $a[1]->q->p > 0) {
        $r = $a[0];
        for ($i = 1; $i < $a[1]->q->p; $i++) {
            $r = distribute($r, $a[0]);
        }
        return $r;
    }
    return rebuild($f, $a);
}
function numeric(Expr $f): float
{
    global $half;
    if ($f->kind === 5) {
        return $f->q->p / $f->q->q;
    }
    if ($f->kind === 1 || $f->kind === 2) {
        $r = $f->kind === 1 ? 0.0 : 1.0;
        foreach ($f->args as $a) {
            $v = numeric($a);
            $r = $f->kind === 1 ? $r + $v : $r * $v;
        }
        return $r;
    }
    if ($f->kind === 3) {
        $u = numeric($f->args[0]);
        $z = numeric($f->args[1]);
        $integral = $f->args[1]->kind === 5 ? integerForm($f->args[1]) : $z === floor($z);
        if ($u < 0 && !$integral) {
            throw new RuntimeException("domain error");
        }
        return $f->args[1] == $half ? sqrt($u) : $u ** $z;
    }
    $a = numeric($f->args[0]);
    if ($f->name === "ln" && $a <= 0) {
        throw new RuntimeException("domain error");
    }
    return match ($f->name) {
        "ln" => log($a),
        "sin" => sin($a),
        "cos" => cos($a),
        "tan" => tan($a),
        default => exp($a),
    };
}
function atomic(Expr $f): bool
{
    global $half;
    return in_array($f->kind, [0, 4]) ||
        (integerForm($f) && $f->q->p >= 0) ||
        ($f->kind === 3 && $f->args[1] == $half);
}
function atom(Expr $f): string
{
    return atomic($f) ? show($f) : "(" . show($f) . ")";
}
function showPower(Expr $b, Expr $x): string
{
    global $half;
    return $x == $half ? "sqrt(" . show($b) . ")" : atom($b) . "^" . atom($x);
}
function factor(Expr $f): string
{
    return $f->kind === 1
        ? "(" . show($f) . ")"
        : ($f->kind === 3
            ? showPower(...$f->args)
            : show($f));
}
function quotient(Rational $c, array $a): string
{
    $p = abs($c->p);
    $top = $p === 1 ? [] : [(string) $p];
    $bottom = $c->q === 1 ? [] : [(string) $c->q];
    foreach ($a as $f) {
        if (negativePower($f)) {
            $r = num($f->args[1]->q->negative());
            $bottom[] = $r->q->p === $r->q->q ? factor($f->args[0]) : showPower($f->args[0], $r);
        } else {
            $top[] = factor($f);
        }
    }
    $s = $top ? implode("*", $top) : "1";
    if (count($bottom) === 1) {
        $s .= "/" . $bottom[0];
    } elseif ($bottom) {
        $s .= "/(" . implode("*", $bottom) . ")";
    }
    return ($c->p < 0 ? "-" : "") . $s;
}
function show(Expr $f): string
{
    if ($f->kind === 5) {
        return $f->q->p . ($f->q->q === 1 ? "" : "/" . $f->q->q);
    }
    if ($f->kind === 0) {
        return $f->name;
    }
    if ($f->kind === 4) {
        return $f->name . "(" . show($f->args[0]) . ")";
    }
    if ($f->kind === 3) {
        return negativePower($f) ? quotient(new Rational(1), [$f]) : showPower(...$f->args);
    }
    if ($f->kind === 2) {
        return quotient(...coefficient($f));
    }
    $s = show($f->args[0]);
    foreach (array_slice($f->args, 1) as $a) {
        $t = show($a);
        $s .= $t[0] === "-" ? " - " . substr($t, 1) : " + " . $t;
    }
    return $s;
}
final readonly class Syntax
{
    public function __construct(public string $op, public ?Expr $value, public array $args = []) {}
}
final class Parser
{
    private array $tokens = [];
    private int $position = 0;
    public function __construct(string $text, private array $names)
    {
        preg_match_all("~[0-9]+|[a-z][a-z0-9]*|[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*|[-+*/^()]| +|.~", $text, $m);
        foreach ($m[0] as $t) {
            if ($t[0] === " ") {
                continue;
            }
            if (!preg_match("~\A[a-zA-Z0-9+*/^()-]+\z~", $t)) {
                throw new RuntimeException("invalid character '$t'");
            }
            $this->tokens[] = $t;
        }
    }
    private function peek(): string
    {
        return $this->tokens[$this->position] ?? "";
    }
    private function unexpected(): never
    {
        $t = $this->peek();
        throw new RuntimeException($t === "" ? "unexpected end of expression" : "unexpected '$t'");
    }
    private function accept(string $s): bool
    {
        if ($this->peek() !== $s) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->position++;
        return true;
    }
    private function expect(string $s): void
    {
        if (!$this->accept($s)) {
            $this->unexpected();
        }
    }
    private function atomTree(): Syntax
    {
        $t = $this->peek();
        if ($t === "") {
            $this->unexpected();
        }
        if ($this->accept("(")) {
            $a = $this->expression();
            $this->expect(")");
            return $a;
        }
        if (!ctype_alnum($t[0])) {
            $this->unexpected();
        }
        $this->position++;
        if (ctype_digit($t[0])) {
            return new Syntax("", num((int) $t));
        }
        if (ctype_upper($t[0])) {
            if (!isset($this->names[$t])) {
                throw new RuntimeException("undefined name '$t'");
            }
            return new Syntax("", $this->names[$t]);
        }
        if (!in_array($t, FUNCTIONS)) {
            return new Syntax("", node(0, [], $t));
        }
        $this->expect("(");
        $a = $this->expression();
        $this->expect(")");
        return new Syntax($t, null, [$a]);
    }
    private function unary(): Syntax
    {
        if ($this->accept("-")) {
            return new Syntax("neg", null, [$this->unary()]);
        }
        $a = $this->atomTree();
        return $this->accept("^") ? new Syntax("^", null, [$a, $this->unary()]) : $a;
    }
    private function term(): Syntax
    {
        $a = $this->unary();
        while (in_array($this->peek(), ["*", "/"])) {
            $op = $this->tokens[$this->position++];
            $a = new Syntax($op, null, [$a, $this->unary()]);
        }
        return $a;
    }
    private function expression(): Syntax
    {
        $a = $this->term();
        while (in_array($this->peek(), ["+", "-"])) {
            $op = $this->tokens[$this->position++];
            $a = new Syntax($op, null, [$a, $this->term()]);
        }
        return $a;
    }
    private function evaluate(Syntax $t): Expr
    {
        global $minus;
        if ($t->value !== null) {
            return $t->value;
        }
        $a = array_map(fn($s) => $this->evaluate($s), $t->args);
        return match ($t->op) {
            "+" => add(...$a),
            "-" => add($a[0], multiply($minus, $a[1])),
            "*" => multiply(...$a),
            "/" => multiply($a[0], power($a[1], $minus)),
            "^" => power(...$a),
            "neg" => multiply($minus, $a[0]),
            default => applyFunction($t->op, $a[0]),
        };
    }
    public function parse(): Expr
    {
        $t = $this->expression();
        if ($this->position < count($this->tokens)) {
            $this->unexpected();
        }
        return $this->evaluate($t);
    }
}
function variableName(string $s): bool
{
    return (bool) preg_match("~\A[a-z][a-z0-9]*\z~", $s) && !in_array($s, FUNCTIONS);
}
function rationalLiteral(string $s): bool
{
    return (bool) preg_match("~\A-?[0-9]+(?:/[0-9]+)?\z~", $s);
}
function literal(string $s): Expr
{
    if (!rationalLiteral($s)) {
        throw new RuntimeException("invalid number '$s'");
    }
    $a = explode("/", $s);
    return num((int) $a[0], isset($a[1]) ? (int) $a[1] : 1);
}
const SIGNATURES = [
    "SIMPLIFY" => "e",
    "EXPAND" => "e",
    "DIFF" => "ev",
    "DIFFN" => "evn",
    "GRAD" => "e",
    "HESSIAN" => "e",
    "IMPLICIT" => "evv",
    "SUBST" => "eve",
    "EVAL" => "ea",
    "TANGENT" => "evc",
    "LIMIT" => "evc",
    "TAYLOR" => "evcn",
];
function command(string $line, array &$names): array
{
    global $zero, $minus;
    $parts = explode(" ", $line, 2);
    $c = $parts[0];
    $arg = $parts[1] ?? "";
    if ($c === "LET") {
        if (!str_contains($arg, "=")) {
            throw new RuntimeException("wrong number of arguments");
        }
        [$s, $text] = explode("=", $arg, 2);
        $s = trim($s, " ");
        if (!preg_match("~\A[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*\z~", $s)) {
            throw new RuntimeException("invalid name '$s'");
        }
        $f = new Parser(trim($text, " "), $names)->parse();
        $names[$s] = $f;
        return ["$s = " . show($f)];
    }
    if (!isset(SIGNATURES[$c])) {
        throw new RuntimeException("unknown command $c");
    }
    $fields = isset($parts[1]) ? array_map(fn($s) => trim($s, " "), explode(";", $arg)) : [];
    $sig = SIGNATURES[$c];
    if ($c === "EVAL" ? !in_array(count($fields), [1, 2]) : count($fields) !== strlen($sig)) {
        throw new RuntimeException("wrong number of arguments");
    }
    $a = [];
    foreach ($fields as $i => $s) {
        switch ($sig[$i]) {
            case "e":
                $a[] = new Parser($s, $names)->parse();
                break;
            case "v":
                if (!variableName($s)) {
                    throw new RuntimeException("invalid variable '$s'");
                }
                $a[] = $s;
                break;
            case "n":
                if (!preg_match("~\A[1-8]\z~", $s)) {
                    throw new RuntimeException("invalid order '$s'");
                }

                break;
            case "c":

                break;
            default:
                $a[] = $s;
        }
    }
    $f = $a[0];
    $v = $a[1] ?? "";
    $x = $a[2] ?? $zero;
    $out = [];
    if ($c === "SIMPLIFY") {
        return ["simplified: " . show($f)];
    }
    if ($c === "EXPAND") {
        return ["expanded: " . show(expandForm($f))];
    }
    if ($c === "DIFF") {
        return ["d/d$v = " . show(derivative($f, $v))];
    }
    if ($c === "DIFFN") {
        for ($k = 1; $k <= $x; $k++) {
            $f = derivative($f, $v);
            $out[] = "d^$k/d$v^$k = " . show($f);
        }
        return $out;
    }
    if ($c === "GRAD" || $c === "HESSIAN") {
        $vs = variables($f);
        if (!$vs) {
            return ["no variables"];
        }
        foreach ($vs as $i => $s) {
            $d = derivative($f, $s);
            if ($c === "GRAD") {
                $out[] = "d/d$s = " . show($d);
            } else {
                foreach (array_slice($vs, $i) as $t) {
                    $out[] = "d2/d{$s}d$t = " . show(derivative($d, $t));
                };
            }
        }
        return $out;
    }
    if ($c === "IMPLICIT") {
        if ($v === $x) {
            throw new RuntimeException("same variable");
        }
        return [
            "d$x/d$v = " .
            show(multiply($minus, derivative($f, $v), power(derivative($f, $x), $minus))),
        ];
    }
    if ($c === "SUBST") {
        return ["substituted: " . show(substitute($f, [$v => $x]))];
    }
    if ($c === "EVAL") {
        $values = [];
        foreach (array_filter(explode(" ", $v), fn($s) => $s !== "") as $word) {
            $pair = explode("=", $word, 2);
            $s = $pair[0];
            $text = $pair[1] ?? "";
            if (count($pair) !== 2 || !variableName($s) || !rationalLiteral($text)) {
                throw new RuntimeException("invalid assignment '$word'");
            }
            $q = literal($text);
            if (isset($values[$s])) {
                throw new RuntimeException("duplicate variable $s");
            }
            $values[$s] = $q;
        }
        foreach (variables($f) as $s) {
            if (!isset($values[$s])) {
                throw new RuntimeException("no value for $s");
            }
        }
        $r = substitute($f, $values);
        return [
            $r->kind === 5
                ? "exact: " . show($r)
                : "approx: " . number_format(numeric($r), 6, ".", ""),
        ];
    }
    $point = [$v => $x];
    if ($c === "TANGENT") {
        $m = substitute(derivative($f, $v), $point);
        $y = substitute($f, $point);
        $z = node(0, [], $v);
        $t =
            "tangent: y = " . show(add(multiply($m, $z), $y, multiply(num($x->q->negative()), $m)));
        if ($m == $zero) {
            return [$t, "normal: $v = " . show($x)];
        }
        $k = power($m, $minus);
        return [$t, "normal: y = " . show(add(multiply($minus, $k, $z), $y, multiply($x, $k)))];
    }
    if ($c === "LIMIT") {
        $top = [];
        $bottom = [];
        foreach ($f->kind === 2 ? $f->args : [$f] as $t) {
            if (negativePower($t)) {
                $bottom[] = power($t->args[0], num($t->args[1]->q->negative()));
            } else {
                $top[] = $t;
            }
        }
        $g = multiply(...$top);
        $h = multiply(...$bottom);
        for ($i = 0; $i <= 5; $i++) {
            $u = substitute($g, $point);
            $b = substitute($h, $point);
            if ($b != $zero) {
                return ["limit: " . show(multiply($u, power($b, $minus)))];
            }
            if ($u != $zero) {
                return ["limit: unbounded"];
            }
            if ($i < 5) {
                $g = derivative($g, $v);
                $h = derivative($h, $v);
            }
        }
        return ["limit: unknown"];
    }
    $n = $a[3];
    $ds = [$f];
    for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
        $ds[] = derivative($ds[count($ds) - 1], $v);
    }
    $ps = [];
    $fac = 1;
    for ($i = 0; $i <= $n; $i++) {
        if ($i) {
            $fac *= $i;
        }
        $co = multiply(substitute($ds[$i], $point), num(1, $fac));
        $ps[] = multiply($co, power(add(node(0, [], $v), num($x->q->negative())), num($i)));
    }
    return ["taylor: " . show(expandForm(add(...$ps)))];
}
$names = [];
$count = (int) trim(fgets(STDIN));
for ($i = 0; $i < $count; $i++) {
    try {
        foreach (command(rtrim(fgets(STDIN), "\r\n"), $names) as $line) {
            echo $line, "\n";
        }
    } catch (RuntimeException $e) {
        echo "error: ", $e->getMessage(), "\n";
    }
}
